title: Add safeguard_trial mechanism for OLY-9-06
summary: Add crates/athena-core/src/safeguard_trial.rs, which judges a proposed safeguard on similar defects caught, regressions and overhead against explicit limits, and record it as OLY-9-06's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml. Audience: Apollo, who accepts Phase 3 and judges the verdict.

defaults_applied.how: Unit tests in the new module; fmt, clippy and test criteria.
Behavior criterion runs the tests that exercise accept and each reject path.
One new module plus spec and changelog edits.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/method_experiment.rs (pure validate/compare functions with unit tests, registered in lib.rs line 109) and docs/spec.toml OLY-9-02..09 and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs docs on measure labels. The new module is a pure library function with no entry point, no records, no data file under crates/, and no refusal rule on past readings, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are not touched; the property is measured directly by counting caught similar defects, regressions and overhead in the module's own inputs.

Design: the safeguard trial takes similar-defect cases (caught or not), regression cases (known-good work wrongly blocked), baseline and with-safeguard overhead, and limits (minimum catch rate, max regressions, max overhead ratio); output is Accepted or Rejected(reason) or Refused(input).
Existing code: extends the pattern of crates/athena-core/src/method_experiment.rs and edits docs/spec.toml and crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs.
Measure uses `status: not shown` with the named test because no `athena status` line reports safeguard trials; wiring into status is out of scope.
Governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) need no change.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml OLY-9-06 has mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/safeguard_trial.rs (not "none"), keeps owner Apollo, and a measure ending in `status: not shown` that names `cargo test -p athena-core safeguard_trial`.
crates/athena-core/src/safeguard_trial.rs exists and is declared with `pub mod safeguard_trial;` in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs; the module doc states the requirement it serves.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core safeguard_trial`: tests show a safeguard that catches enough similar defects within the regression and overhead limits is Accepted; one that misses similar defects, one that causes regressions above the limit, and one whose overhead exceeds the limit are each Rejected with a distinct reason; empty defect set or a missing/zero limit is refused rather than accepted (no empty success). Each rejection test would fail if the corresponding check were removed.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test`: all pass.
CHANGELOG.md gains an entry for safeguard_trial.rs in the style of the method_experiment.rs entry.

out_of_scope: Wiring safeguard trials into `athena status` output or the drain
departures: Small pure-library change modelled on method_experiment.rs, so slightly cheaper and likelier to pass than the reference.
